replies.author: Pavlo
replies.body:
Sorry, your map has been Denied.

The reasons for this are:
  • The middle area and middle lanes are very plain, flat and boring. Try adding some terrain or structure there, and add more detail to the arches.

  • Also the terrain in each sector is nothing special. The terrain is quite flat, except for a small cliff. Try vary the rest of the terrain more. try make it look more natural.

  • The structure also has very minimal detail. This is not so much of a problem, but please try make it look more appealing.

  • Lastly, default trees don't look to good in this, try make custom trees with roots and branches.
Sorry if I sound harsh, I'm just giving my honest opinion. Good luck with fixing this up, and thank you for your submission. :)
